title: Follow a line (smooth)
summary: Steer more when far from the edge, less when close.

steps.title: Open the starter program
steps.text: The robot follows the edge of the oval smoothly instead of zig-zagging.

steps.title: Why it works
steps.text: The program works out an error: how far the light reading is from the edge value of 50. It steers by an amount that is proportional to the error. Engineers call this a P controller (P for proportional). The number 0.4 is the gain. Too small and the robot drifts off the line, too big and it wobbles.

steps.title: Try it 1
steps.text: Try a gain of 0.2 and 0.8. Which follows best?

steps.title: Try it 2
steps.text: Raise the base speed from 25 to 40. Do you need a different gain?

steps.title: Try it 3
steps.text: Compare with the simple line follower using ▶×5.

steps.title: Try it 4
steps.text: Gains that work in the simulator are a starting point. Tune them on the real robot.
